gloss: outside of hours; after hours; overtime

definitions.explanation: Time that falls outside regular operating hours, business hours, or scheduled hours. Used for businesses, hospitals, offices, and other organizations.
Work performed beyond regular working hours. Often used in labor contexts to refer to overtime work and overtime pay.

examples.english: We provide emergency services even outside of regular hours.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time, hours) and ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). The suffix ～⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ is productive in Japanese, forming many similar compounds: {営業時間外|えいぎょうじかんがい} (outside business hours), {管轄外|かんかつがい} (outside jurisdiction), ⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧ (unexpected).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間外|じかんがい}{労働|ろうどう}: overtime work
- {時間外|じかんがい}{手当|てあて}: overtime pay
- {時間外|じかんがい}⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧: after-hours medical treatment
- {時間外|じかんがい}⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: after-hours reception
- {時間外|じかんがい}⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: after-hours counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧: overtime work — more common in everyday conversation for sense 2
- {営業時間外|えいぎょうじかんがい}: outside business hours — more specific version of sense 1
- {勤務時間外|きんむじかんがい}: outside working hours — more specific for employment context
